paite: "Vai hawmsak kei un, vai hawmsak na hihlouhna ding un.
heading: Midangte Vaihawmsak Thu A Thuhilhna / (Luk 6.7-38,41-42)

paite: Na vai hawmsak mah bang un hawmsak in na om ding uh, na tehna ngei mah un hon tehsak nawn ding uh.
Huan bangziak a, nangmah mit a singtum om ngaihtuah lou a, na unau mit a ninneng neuchik mu na hia?
Bangchi in na unau kiang ah, na mit a kipan huai ninneng neuchik hon lakhesak ve, na chih theih ding? Ngai in, nangmah mit mahmah ah singtum a-om nilouh ngal a.
Milepchiah, na mit a kipan singtum lakhe masa in; huchi in na unau mit a kipan ninneng neuchik lakkhiak ding kichiantak in na mu thei ding hi.
"Ui kiang ah thil siangthou pe kei un; vok ma ah na tuikepsuang uh pai kei un, achilse kha ding ua, huan kihei in nang ahon balzak kha ding uh.
heading: Thil Siangthou Nitsakna

paite: "Ngen un, piak in na om ding uh; zong un, na mu ding uh; kiu un, hon honsak ding uh.
heading: Thum Ding A Thuhilhna / (Luk 11.9-13)

paite: Kuapeuh angen in angah a; kuapeuh azong in amu a; akiu peuhmah honsak in a-om ding hi.
Ahihleh noute kuapeuh na tapa un tanghou ngen taleh, kua'n suang pe ding na hi ua?
Ahihkeileh ngasa ngen taleh, kua'n gul pe ding na hi ua?
Huchi hileh nou migilou in bawn, na tate uh thil hoih piakdan na theih un, na Pa uh van a om in angente thil hoih pe zaw sem lou ding hia?
"Huaiziak in mi'n na tung ua thil bangpeuh hih ding a na deih bang uh, mi tung ah leng hih sam un; huai Dan leh zawlneite thu ahi him hi.
heading: Chindan Hoih

paite: "Kong kochik ah lut un; manthatna a paina kong aza a, alampi leng alian a, huai a lut tam leng atam mahmah uhi.
heading: Kong Kochik A Lutna / (Luk 13.24)

paite: Hinna a paina kong akochik a, alampi aneu a, atawnte tawmchik ahi uh.
"Zawlnei takloute lak ah pilvang un, amaute belam vun silh in na kiang uah ahong pai nak ua, asunglam uh nge duhgawl pipi ahi uh.
heading: Sing Leh Agah / (Luk 6.43-44)

paite: Amaute agah uah na thei mai ding uh. Khaulingnei gui ah grep gah alou ngei ua hia? Lenling ah theipi a lou ngei ua hia?
Huchi mah bang in sing hoih peuhmah agah ahoih a; sing sia agah ase nak.
Sing hoih agah ase thei kei, sing sia agah ahoih thei sam kei hi.
Sing chih gah hoih lou aphuk ua, mei ah apai uhi.
Huaiziak in amaute agah uah na thei mai ding uhi.
"Toupa, Toupa, hon chi na peuh van-gam ah alut kei ding uh; ka Pa van a om deihlam hihte alut ding uhi.
heading: Toupa Theih Mite

paite: Huai ni chiang in mi tampi'n, Toupa, na min in thute ka gen ua, na min in dawite ka delhkhia ua, na min in thillamdang tampi ka hih zel uh hilou hiam? achi ding uh.
Huai hun chiang in, 'Nou thil gilou hihte aw, ka hon thei ngei kei, ka kiang a kipan paimang un, chi in amaute ka hilh ding hi.'
"Huchi in michih hiai ka thu za a, zui peuhmah, mipil suangpi tung a inn lammi toh ka tehpih ding hi.
heading: Inn Lamdan Nihte / (Luk 6.47-49)

paite: Vuahpi hong zu in tui ahong khang a, huih ahong nung a, huai inn hon mut zialzial a; himahleh achim kei; suangpi tung a lepkip ahih ziak in.
Huan michih, hiai ka thu za a zom lou peuhmah, mihai piaunel tung a inn lammi toh ka teh ding hi.
Vuah hong zu in tui ahong khang a, huih ahong nung a, huai inn hon mut zialzial a; achimta a, huai inn anakchip ngel hi," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu'n huai thu agen zoh in, mipi'n athuhilh lamdang asa mahmah uh;
laigelhmite bang lou a, thuneihna neitak a amaute thu ahilh ziak in.
